topic: Whole-harness observation and corrective-response repair scope
observations: Three independent read-only reviews and cross-review identify bounded but unclosed paths from high-signal project feedback to later planning/consumer verification.
A reproducible defect shows replay aggregation accepts input rejected by the canonical validator, but no activation decision using invalid input was observed.
Sazu evidence shows plan lifecycle/status reconciliation risk but does not prove a global causal pattern or that removing Superpowers caused the drift.
Current static health checks correctly prove their stated limited contracts; they do not prove operational semantic health.
options: Patch only the replay summarizer validation defect and retain all other observation boundaries.
Run a project-local Sazu active-plan and consumer-evidence reconciliation trial, collect a second independent project observation, then reconsider global adoption.
Immediately add a global active-plan/feedback-consumption/consumer-evidence policy and validator to Chohogi.
selected: No immediate global asset change; create a provisional candidate with a bounded Sazu trial plus a narrowly scoped replay-validator parity correction proposal.
rationale: The aggregate audit proves one local tool defect and several declared observability limits, but it does not yet prove a single global mechanism or establish the behavioral cost/false-positive profile of a broad policy. A project-local trial can test whether explicit plan lifecycle and consumer-evidence obligations close the observed gap without reintroducing an external controller.
reviewTrigger: Reopen for a global change if the Sazu trial demonstrates the guard catching its stated signature and a second independent project exhibits the same signature, or if a concrete activation decision consumes invalid replay aggregation.

tradeoffs.benefit: tests causal mechanism with limited blast radius
tradeoffs.cost: delays global policy and needs a second observation
high false-positive, document overhead, and controller-regression risk without cross-project evidence

deliveryCost.basis: audit evidence only; no implementation estimate

reversibility: Narrow patch is readily reversible; project-local trial is bounded; a global policy and validator affect runtime guidance, installation, records, fixtures, and replay evidence and require formal rollback.
unknowns: whether a project-local active-plan contract changes consumer-integration outcomes
whether manual feedback discovery already closes the observed Markdown retrieval gap in practice
whether replay summarization is consumed in an activation decision

selected: Project-local Sazu active-plan and consumer-evidence reconciliation trial, plus a separate narrow replay-validator parity correction proposal; defer global policy activation.
summary: User directed that the confirmed observability problem must proceed. The bounded trial recommendation is accepted; no global controller restoration or immediate global policy activation is authorized.
